chunks: From him, from al-Nadr, from 'Asim ibn Humayd, from Abu Basir, who said:

I heard Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) saying: 'Three breaths are superior in drinking to one breath, and he disliked being imitated by the 'heem' (those who gulp), and he said: The 'heem' is the 'neeb' (the one who swallows quickly).'
ai.seo_question: What is the recommended manner of drinking according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (AS) recommends drinking in three breaths to avoid the excessive, rapid consumption known as 'al-heem' (gulping), which he equates with 'al-neeb' (swallowing whole). This practice reflects the Shia emphasis on moderation and mindful consumption, distinguishing believers from those who consume food and drink without restraint or gratitude.
